reviewer_inputs: Exact randomized-ID final answers, unchanged question/rubric, this contract and full frozen source only. No profile, run/pair ID, trajectory, resources, past scores or private mapping. Disclose reviewer reuse and prior exposure. Model review is not official SWE-QA or human grading.
rules: Use exactly the ten original independent one-point factual units C1.1 through C5.2. Each unit is 0 or 1, grouped criterion sums are 0 through 2, total maximum is 10. Preserve null for an unresolved material interpretation. Do not require a patch or an executed test.

Preserve the rubric success formula: nonempty final answer, total >=8, all six C3-C5 units awarded, sufficient submitted core citations for all four relationships in success_rule.core_citations_required_for, and no substantiated material contradiction to an asked conclusion.

Separate factual points from citation support. Missing citations cannot erase a correct factual unit, but may fail a required core citation gate. Reviewer-added evidence cannot repair an absent answer citation. Accept equivalent source locations and combined caller/callee explanations without requiring curated evidence IDs, every wrapper, exact function names or a fixed count of files.

C1-C2 concern the stated identifier-validation stage, distinct collection/field rules and document UTF-8 byte length. Do not turn collection-name validation into a claim about successful filesystem creation. Judge the actual stated identifiers and 341/342 Han-character cases; an exhaustive list of other restrictions is not required.

C3-C4 distinguish whole-batch validation before any write from per-document write statuses. In the stated TAB batch, all document validation precedes writing, the overall result is INVALID_ARGUMENT and Python raises ValueError without returning a per-item status list. This is not evidence of transaction atomicity under arbitrary later I/O failures.

C4-C5 distinguish an overall unexpected result from a successful vector containing ALREADY_EXISTS. In the stated duplicate batch, statuses are OK, ALREADY_EXISTS, OK, the fresh documents are inserted, and the existing document keeps its old payload because INSERT returns before mutation. No UPSERT or extra failure scenario is implied.

For a material contradiction, quote the exact answer text, cite the frozen source, and explain how the claim changes an asked conclusion. An omission or ambiguous phrase is not automatically an explicit opposite claim. Do not introduce extra disqualifying keywords or unrelated requirements.

Return ten unit decisions with answer quotes and source support, five criterion sums, submitted citation verdicts and the four core gates, a material-contradiction audit, total and success. No token, timing or tool-benefit conclusion belongs in blinded grading.

Persist the original report and an independent consistency report before mapping read. Preserve original reports and unresolved judgments; do not choose favorable interpretations, zero-fill unknowns, delete an answer or silently change the rubric.
development_selection_disclosure: q005 was selected from the retained closed-issue pool in its existing order after a prospective runtime/API case filter. Exact question, source evidence and canonical assets were independently reviewed before any native q005 solver answer. Other development-case outcomes are known to the parent. This is a development case, not a randomly sampled or unseen holdout.
statistics: One fresh pair supports a development observation only. No trimming for one repetition. A later ten-per-profile confirmation requires a separate pre-execution cohort freeze and excludes development answers. Task-level MAD cannot treat repetitions as independent tasks.
